processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Five Cu molds filled stepwise from a 4-kg ingot; after each cast the remaining melt composition was adjusted by charging Al through an air lock.
10 × 50 × 130 mm³-sized blocks hot rolled into 2 ± 0.1 mm thick and ~500 mm long sheets.
After reheating and water quenching, sheets were cut perpendicular to the rolling direction into sets of nine segments (2 × 60 × 55 mm³) for each alloy composition.
Aging at 550 °C for 24 h followed by oil quenching; this is the defining heat treatment of the sample.
Scales were removed from the surfaces by low-pressure, fine-grit sandblasting after the heat treatments.
Samples for mechanical testing and microstructure investigation were prepared from the segments by package spark erosion.

structures.overall_structure: Fully recrystallized single-phase austenitic (fcc) microstructure with ~20 µm grain size and some retained Mn microsegregations.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: All plotted values represent averages of three measurements for every material state.

ultimate_tensile_strength.uncertainty: approximate range; the Fig. 4 cluster includes all aging conditions for the 4Al alloy

elongation.uncertainty: approximate range; the Fig. 4 cluster includes all aging conditions for the 4Al alloy

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature; initial strain rate 10^-3 s^-1
characterization_methods.purpose: Mechanical screening of yield strength, ultimate tensile strength and total elongation.
characterization_methods.key_findings: YS ~350–450 MPa; UTS ~460–600 MPa; TE ~8–55% (approximate ranges from Figs. 3 and 4 for the 4Al alloy).
~200 HBW (approximate from Fig. 3d for the 4Al alloy).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Cross-sectional areas prepared in the plane perpendicular to the rolling direction by grinding and polishing with standard metallographic techniques.
characterization_methods.purpose: Microstructure investigation and checking for cracks, pores or macrosegregations.
characterization_methods.key_findings: No cracks, pores or macrosegregations; fully recrystallized microstructure with ~20 µm grain size and some retained Mn microsegregations.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Performed on the rolling plane of samples ground to a thickness of 1 mm.
characterization_methods.key_findings: Single austenite phase prevails at room temperature for Al content below 5 wt.% (Fe-30Mn-1.2C-4Al).

unmapped_findings: The Fe-30Mn-1.2C-4Al alloy is an intermediate Al variant: its mechanical data fall between those of the Al-free Fe-30Mn-1.2C alloy (weakening/embrittlement on aging) and the Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al alloy (strengthening on aging) [b0024].

Alloys with 4 wt.% and 6 wt.% Al are only very weakly affected by the applied aging treatments (450/500/550/600 °C for 1 h and 24 h) in terms of their mechanical data, compared with Fe-30Mn-1.2C and Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al [b0024].

The intermediate alloy variants with 2–6 wt.% Al do not show equivalent mechanical properties to the ~8 wt.% Al variant, and a much smaller influence of aging on the tensile behavior is observed in the 2–6 wt.% Al cases [b0025].
